newsitem.title: UK: MAVERICK BANKS NEW BRITISH SPORTS MINISTER.
newsitem.headline: MAVERICK BANKS NEW BRITISH SPORTS MINISTER.

text.p: Britain's new Labour Prime Minister Tony Blair appointed maverick left-winger Tony Banks as sports minister on Monday.
Banks, who like outgoing Prime Minister John Major is a keen supporter of Chelsea Football Club, is fiercely opposed to foxhunting and renowned in parliament for his sharp wit.
Banks, who has been a member of parliament for 10 years, has in the past been reprimanded in the House of Commons for his colourful language.
He once called portly defence minister Nicholas Soames "his own personal food mountain" and also urged the government to legalise the smoking of cannabis.
